basic_profile.bio: I'm a 26-year-old recent graduate with a degree in Finance, currently living in Austin, Texas. I work as a junior financial analyst at a mid-sized firm. When I'm not crunching numbers, I love tinkering with my Ender 5 Plus 3D printer and recording music with my Presonus audio interface. I'm single and enjoy spending my evenings browsing Reddit, especially on financial advice and tech forums, from around 7 PM to midnight.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a finance degree and a year and a half of professional experience, I have a solid understanding of personal finance, investment strategies, and market analysis. I often share insights I've gleaned from both formal education and real-world application in my job.
